purpose: Reproducible inventory of current Goodies source. A binding, handler, route or contract trace is never hosted acceptance or a role authorization PASS.

sourceSnapshot.limitation: Subsequent source edits invalidate this snapshot; rerun before reporting final evidence.

classificationRules.SOURCE_TRACE: Current source was parsed or hashed; behavior, authorization and outcomes have not been executed by this generator.
classificationRules.HOSTED_NOT_VERIFIED: No signed-in hosted button, cross-role, provider or device acceptance was performed.

scopeRules.sharedVendorFunctions: Existing vendor.json includedFunctions are retained; whole-file hashes/comment metadata cover shared files but AST controls/calls are limited to the named functions and their nested callbacks.
scopeRules.additions: Dedicated src/features/Goodies TS/TSX/JSON, BusinessSpaceGoodies files, goodiesTemplates and goodies services; actual admin navigation implementation and isolated preview port/manifest metadata.
scopeRules.exclusions: Unrelated service screens, SQL, environment/credential files, node_modules, generated admin consumer mirror controls, and test execution. Test files listed by the courier report receive metadata only.

routeValidation.scope: Only literal targets at recognized calls are compared with current source registries. Dynamic expressions and unrecognized call aliases are not exhaustively validated.

customer.registry: GoodiesApp switch(r) and delegated Account switch(r) case clauses

limitations: Static bindings are instances in source; mapped rows, conditional render branches and spread props do not yield an exhaustive runtime button count.
Object callback/action properties are included conservatively and may include a non-UI callback.
Full handler expressions and named function ranges identify source logic; no handler, permission path, RPC, payment or provider was executed.
Service imports outside the bounded source scope remain explicit dependency edges; this inventory does not recursively audit unrelated modules.
Demo/reference categories describe source location, not proof of isolation or a production-data defect. Input placeholders, GPS samples and comments require their recorded context.
Embedded HTML/script event references are recorded separately and are not exhaustively parsed browser bindings.
Whole-file hashes can change while other agents edit; rerun after final source synchronization.
